inline_style_policy.reason: Chart geometry and palette swatches encode data. Layout, typography, spacing, and interaction styling remain in shared CSS.

components.use_when: Compare the same chat, buttons, and status labels in current and candidate colors before changing shared tokens.
components.do_not: Do not infer runtime status from specimen colors or apply this candidate to production implicitly.
components.responsive: Stack the two palettes when the container is narrow; preserve visible HEX values and copy targets.
components.a11y: Label swatches, expose computed contrast and failures as text, and keep both sample palettes light when the surrounding gallery theme changes.

components.use_when: Present one measured outcome with a short comparison.
components.do_not: Do not use KPI cards for prose, actions, or unverified claims.
components.responsive: Keep the value dominant and reduce columns before labels wrap.
components.a11y: Expose the value and evidence state as text, not color alone.

components.use_when: Label a compact semantic category or operational state.
components.do_not: Do not use a tag as an editable policy record or as the only status cue.
components.responsive: Wrap tokens without changing their semantic order.
components.a11y: Retain readable labels and never depend on dot color alone.

components.use_when: Apply semantic text roles across Console and mock surfaces.
components.do_not: Do not introduce route-local font sizes when a semantic role fits.
components.responsive: Preserve hierarchy and allow long Korean text and identifiers to wrap.
components.a11y: Keep primary content readable at 200 percent zoom.

components.use_when: Collect dates, times, and bounded numeric values.
components.do_not: Do not replace native date and time semantics with decorative controls.
components.responsive: Stack paired fields before either field becomes narrower than its value.
components.a11y: Keep native labels, keyboard increments, and value output associations.

components.use_when: Search bounded observed resources or filter local records.
components.do_not: Do not let browser text mint scope, identity, or execution authority.
components.responsive: Keep results within the viewport and cap visible options.
components.a11y: Use combobox semantics, active descendant, and announced result counts.

components.use_when: Choose from rich options that require secondary metadata.
components.do_not: Do not use a custom select for a short stable native option set.
components.responsive: Anchor menus to the field and constrain them to the viewport.
components.a11y: Use listbox semantics, roving focus, and explicit selected state.

components.use_when: Submit a bounded local or Operator API request.
components.do_not: Do not create route-local button, field, or save-bar equivalents.
components.responsive: Use 34px desktop controls, 28px compact actions, and 44px touch targets.
components.a11y: Use native controls, visible focus, labels, help, and inline errors.

components.use_when: Switch peer views or show bounded progress.
components.do_not: Do not use tabs as route navigation or meters without a verified denominator.
components.responsive: Allow tab scrolling before labels clip.
components.a11y: Use tab, tabpanel, selected state, and keyboard navigation.

components.use_when: Choose one option, several options, or a reversible preference.
components.do_not: Do not use a switch for a destructive or approval-bearing operation.
components.responsive: Expand segmented and switch targets to 44px on touch viewports.
components.a11y: Use native input state and text labels in addition to visual tracks.

components.use_when: Explain a local state, limitation, or required attention.
components.do_not: Do not present operational success from dispatch or API acceptance alone.
components.responsive: Stack actions without separating them from their message.
components.a11y: Use status or alert roles only when the urgency warrants announcement.

components.use_when: Name an operational state, decision mode, or risk classification.
components.do_not: Do not translate raw machine enums into unlabeled color.
components.responsive: Wrap labels while preserving the state text.
components.a11y: Keep complete textual state and non-color selection cues.

components.use_when: Confirm local interaction or explain unfamiliar controls.
components.do_not: Do not hide essential instructions only in a tooltip.
components.responsive: Clamp overlays and return focus without moving primary content.
components.a11y: Retain focus, escape handling, reduced motion, and announcement roles.

components.use_when: Represent authoritative data lifecycle and evidence gaps.
components.do_not: Do not collapse unavailable, empty, and failed into the same state.
components.responsive: Keep state text readable without fabricating values.
components.a11y: Use one loading status, hide decorative skeleton blocks, and announce errors.

components.use_when: Compare repeated records across stable columns.
components.do_not: Do not force a table when each row needs a different structure.
components.responsive: Use row labels or bounded horizontal scrolling based on comparison needs.
components.a11y: Retain caption, column headers, scope, and meaningful row order.

components.use_when: Visualize verified numeric relationships with an inspectable data table.
components.do_not: Do not select a chart from prose or display an unverified denominator.
components.responsive: Keep two representative previews visible and move the full catalog to a subview.
components.a11y: Provide chart description, exact data inspection, keyboard marks, and text fallback.

components.use_when: Present exact source or a governance artifact without rewriting it.
components.do_not: Do not use syntax color as the only distinction or alter copied source.
components.responsive: Keep code scroll local and prevent page-level horizontal overflow.
components.a11y: Preserve readable text, tab semantics, copy feedback, and file identity.

components.use_when: Present repeated entities with consistent metadata and actions.
components.do_not: Do not make a whole card interactive when it contains independent controls.
components.responsive: Reduce columns before names or identifiers clip.
components.a11y: Use native links or explicit row actions with accessible names.

components.use_when: Show ordered observed activity or a source lifecycle.
components.do_not: Do not infer missing steps or use timeline position as evidence.
components.responsive: Keep event order and timestamps visible in a single column.
components.a11y: Use ordered semantics and explicit status text for each event.

components.use_when: Inspect bounded detail without losing list context.
components.do_not: Do not place primary navigation or irreversible work only in an overlay.
components.responsive: Use full-width presentation when the remaining viewport is too narrow.
components.a11y: Trap focus when modal, support escape, label the surface, and restore focus.

components.use_when: Preserve route context and confirm local UI feedback.
components.do_not: Do not present a toast as durable operational evidence.
components.responsive: Keep context above actions and notifications within the viewport.
components.a11y: Use polite announcements and explicit dismiss controls.

components.use_when: Express route hierarchy or peer views inside one product surface.
components.do_not: Do not duplicate the Activity Bar, Explorer, and page tabs for the same hierarchy.
components.responsive: Prefer horizontal scrolling or an overlay before labels clip.
components.a11y: Use nav labels, current state, and native links or buttons.

components.use_when: Pair stable labels, values, and bounded actions in repeated rows.
components.do_not: Do not use tags for editable records or hide the value source.
components.responsive: Move the value below its label while keeping actions aligned.
components.a11y: Preserve row grouping, labels, and complete action names.

components.use_when: Compose scoped preferences, explicit save boundaries, schedules, and records with provenance. Settings use 18px section titles, 14px body text, and aligned 320px control columns. Buttons, compact actions, inputs, selects, and individual segmented choices share a 44px height; segmented groups add no vertical padding.
components.do_not: Do not imply that sample selections persist, change language, or grant execution authority.
components.responsive: Stack controls below their labels at 680px container width. Keep every preference control at most 320px wide; wrap long text and five-option groups in very narrow containers.
components.a11y: Use named native controls, pressed state, bold selected labels, visible focus, and explicit disabled save state. Supporting text targets 7:1 contrast and active control boundaries target 3:1.

components.use_when: Compare model metadata and display a bounded deployment allowlist without confusing availability with authority.
components.do_not: Do not render an unavailable model as failed, or let specimen controls save runtime bindings.
components.responsive: Reduce the candidate grid to one column before metadata and action labels become cramped.
components.a11y: Keep provider names, quota availability, and disabled actions explicit; associate inputs with labels.

components.use_when: Compare environment values with durable overrides and show when the effective value can change.
components.do_not: Do not hide revision or effect timing, or treat an unavailable source as a failed operation.
components.responsive: Render labeled table cells and a single-column form below 760px container width.
components.a11y: Preserve captions, table headings, input labels, visible focus, and textual status.

components.use_when: Review identity evidence with a compact summary and a single active workspace tab.
components.do_not: Do not imply that reviewing a request grants access or gives a human the executor identity.
components.responsive: Wrap tabs, reduce summary columns, and retain labeled table cells on narrow screens.
components.a11y: Use tablist and tabpanel semantics, roving focus, arrow keys, Home and End, and a complete active outline.

components.use_when: Show observed health, provenance, source gaps, and asynchronous evidence boundaries in neutral Settings surfaces.
components.do_not: Do not color unknown evidence as a failure or interpret a skeleton or empty result as healthy.
components.responsive: Stack long diagnostic rows while preserving the identity, timestamp, and explicit status.
components.a11y: Expose status in text, give loading one named busy status, and respect reduced motion.

components.use_when: Choose a local date or review an existing schedule.
components.do_not: Do not imply that selecting a date schedules operational work.
components.responsive: Keep grid cells square and move schedule detail below the calendar.
components.a11y: Use grid semantics, complete date labels, selected state, and keyboard movement.
